record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: In the Sun’s core, nuclear fusion joins hydrogen nuclei to form helium and releases energy. NASA identifies that reaction as the source of the Sun’s heat and light; the process is fusion, not fission or radioactive decay.
